note: Prompts and ground paths for Kimodo (kimodo_batch.py). legs: see paths.py. Never put Epic GASP data in here (README.md).
description: Locomotion for motion matching: idle, walk and run loops, circles, starts, stops, 90 degree turns, 180 degree pivots and strafes, at the GASP walker's paces, on dense root path and heading constraints.

clips.name: Idle/Idle_Loop
clips.prompt: A person stands still in a relaxed idle pose, shifting their weight slightly.

clips.name: Idle/Idle_Turn_L90

clips.name: Idle/Idle_Turn_R90

clips.name: Idle/Idle_Turn_L180

clips.name: Idle/Idle_Turn_R180
clips.prompt: A person standing still turns in place around to the right and stands still.

clips.name: Walk/Walk_Pivot_R180
